Immerse Yourself in the Future of Archery at Thrill Factory
Get ready to experience archery like never before with our cutting-edge Indoor Archery facility at Thrill Factory. Step into a world where technology and traditional archery merge seamlessly, creating an exhilarating and immersive adventure. Our state-of-the-art archery range combines multimedia projections and sensor technology to take your archery skills to new heights, making it an unforgettable experience for archery enthusiasts of all levels.
Unleash Your Skills in a Futuristic Environment At Thrill Factory, we believe in pushing the boundaries of adventure. Feel the excitement build up as you draw your bow and release arrows towards virtual targets, watching as your shots come to life through captivating visuals. Safety and Expert Guidance

They will be by your side throughout the experience, offering tips and techniques to enhance your performance and make sure you have a safe and enjoyable time.

Engage your senses, focus your aim, and feel the rush of excitement as you see your arrows hitting virtual bullseyes. The fusion of technology and archery creates an unforgettable experience that will leave you wanting to come back for more.
Visit our Indoor Archery facility at Thrill Factory in Shivpuri, Rishikesh, and prepare for an archery experience that blends tradition with innovation. Challenge yourself in a futuristic environment, test your skills against virtual targets, and immerse yourself in the thrill of this unique archery adventure.
